prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, upper-body portrait, vertical portrait-orientation. One woman centred in the frame, face clearly visible, framed from the very top of her head down to just below the bust, the frame cutting off there. Mid 20s.

A Chinese woman, mid 20s, with an overwhelming glamour hourglass physique with a gigantic towering bust dominating her upper body, a tiny cinched waist and smooth rounded shoulders, and a sweet candy-pop heroine look brought to life, with long pastel mint hair in two high twin tails with curled ends and short wispy bangs, each strand real hair with natural shine, fine flyaways and a few loose wisps. Her eyes are huge, perfectly round eyes with an enormous visible iris in bubblegum pink contact lenses with a darker limbal ring and a round natural pupil, one large bright catchlight and one small catchlight in each iris, a thick drawn lower lash line, long curled lashes, a pastel pink shimmer on the lids and tiny pastel gems under the eyes, under thin, high, simple brows, with real wet eyes and real eyelid skin around them, the eyes taking up about half the width of her face in exaggerated anime proportion, with the iris filling most of the eye opening, set slightly wider apart than normal, with a crisp dark double-eyelid line and a faint luminous ring of light in each iris. Her lips are small and glossy, in a strawberry-pink gradient, deeper in the centre and fading at the edges, lifted in a sweet smile. A deeper pink blush spreads in soft round patches over both cheeks and across the tip of the nose. A tiny nose reduced to a small soft rounded dot with a faint shade beneath it, the bridge and nostrils almost invisible, a very small simple mouth with the corners lifted slightly, a small pointed chin, and a narrow, delicately pointed anime face shape. A sparkling, cheerful, wide-eyed gaze. She is wearing a cosplay costume: a pastel candy-striped satin tube top with a centre front zipper and a lollipop-shaped zip pull, her shoulders and arms bare. Jewelry: on each ear, five separate heavy ear weights of real bright satin tin hanging from a polished silver ring through the lobe, each on its own silver chain of a different length so they hang staggered at different heights and fully visible side by side: on the left ear a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim, a miniature anvil, a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a ship's anchor, a barrel-shaped weight; on the right ear a round bell, a square-sided cowbell, a hammer head, a cube-shaped block, a teardrop-shaped sinker. Every weight is a dense, solid, heavy, satin-finished lump of silvery tin about the size of a large walnut, hanging freely in the air with the longest weight ending at the level of her collarbones, and their weight gently pulls each earlobe down into a soft, slightly elongated, healthy loop of smooth skin. At her neck she wears real layered silver chains of different lengths resting on her collarbones.

Background: a softly blurred candy shop with pastel shelves and sugar-coloured bokeh.

Her skin, across her face, neck, shoulders, chest and arms, is real human skin with visible fine pores across the nose and cheeks, a few tiny freckles and small beauty marks on her face, shoulders, chest and arms, a faint uneven warmth with a pink flush on the cheeks and the tip of the nose, a soft shadow under the eyes, fine natural lines at the corners of the eyes and lips, a light natural sheen on the nose, forehead, collarbones and chest, and the rest of her skin in a soft natural matte finish, real living flesh with warmth. She is a professional cosplayer in a flawless cosplay transformation: large circle lenses, thick false lashes with drawn lower lashes, eyelid tape for a wide double lid, contouring that shrinks the nose and sharpens the chin, and a high-quality wig with a natural hairline and real-looking strands.
Lighting: bright, soft, even light across her face with only gentle shading. Shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. 8K vertical portrait-orientation 3:4 aspect ratio.
